descriptionChirho: To be in a state of mourning or emotional gloom, often describing a person's darkened demeanor as an outward sign of grief or sorrow (Qal intransitive, metaphorical sense).
To become dark or blackened, said of the sky, heavenly bodies, skin, or the earth, describing a physical process of darkening (Qal and Hitpael intransitive).
To make something dark, to bring about darkness upon something, used of God darkening the heavens or celestial bodies as an act of judgment (Hifil causative).
